mechanism: Both drugs have CNS depressant effects; brivaracetam may increase seizure threshold while nalmefene's opioid antagonism could theoretically reduce seizure control in opioid-dependent patients, creating unpredictable neurological effects.
action: Monitor for changes in seizure control and CNS depression; use caution in patients on opioid therapy as nalmefene may precipitate withdrawal and potentially compromise brivaracetam efficacy.
